category_rationales.code_quality: Concise low-complexity modules (207 total LOC, 100% import hygiene, strict stdout/stderr separation), tempered by single-command Typer `scan` subcommand collapse without `@app.callback()`, missing `--version`/`-h`, and eager `read_text()` without `OSError` exit-code-2 handling.
category_rationales.typing: 100.0% function parameter/return annotation coverage and modern Python 3.11+ generics, with minor deductions for `dict[str, Any]` in `formatter.py:report_to_dict`, missing `py.typed`, and absence of a static type checker (`ty`/`pyright`) in dev dependencies.
category_rationales.testing: Hermetic `--network=none` container pytest suite passes 2/2 tests (100% coverage in `models.py` and `analyzer.py`), but overall measured coverage is 67.0% line / 33.3% branch due to 0.0% coverage in `cli.py` and 55.6% in `formatter.py`.
category_rationales.dependencies: Clean PEP 621 `pyproject.toml` and minimal 2-package runtime footprint (`rich`, `typer`), held back by an unresolved 12-line `uv.lock` stub without transitive pins/hashes, missing Dependabot/CI automation, and a 2-line `LICENSE` stub.
category_rationales.security: Strong code security posture (0 CRITICAL/HIGH Python app CVEs, 0 secrets, 0 IaC misconfigs, 0 CWE AST sinks, 0 HTTP routes), tempered by missing `SECURITY.md`, stub `uv.lock` blinding static fs SCA, 5 MEDIUM CVEs in container `pip@25.0.1` (fixed in `26.2.0`), and unvalidated `--min-level` CLI input.
category_rationales.documentation: 88.9% docstring coverage with zero signature mismatches and a clear Quickstart in `README.md`, lacking Standard Readme installation/testing sections, `--min-level`/`--fail-above` flag docs, and two docstrings in `formatter.py`.

structure_map.boundary_assessment: Strict downward dependency DAG verified by `internal_import_graph` with 0 circular dependencies and 0 boundary violations: `parser`, `analyzer`, and `formatter` are mutually decoupled siblings depending solely on `models`, while `cli` acts as the thin top-level orchestrator.

execution_flows.name: CLI Log Scan & Burst Summarization (`logpulse scan`)
steps: 1. CLI Argument & File Check (`cli.py:scan_cmd`): Instantiates stdout/stderr Rich Consoles (`no_color`), verifies `log_file.is_file()` (exits with code 2 on missing file), and loads UTF-8 lines.

2. Resilient JSONL Parsing (`parser.py:parse_jsonl_lines` & `parse_severity`): Parses each non-empty JSON object into immutable `LogEvent` instances (`models.py`), counting malformed JSON or non-dict rows as `skipped` and emitting a stderr warning if `skipped > 0`.

3. Signature Normalization & Ranking (`analyzer.py:build_scan_report` & `normalize_signature`): Filters events >= `min_level`, replaces numeric tokens (`\b\d+\b`) with `<N>`, aggregates counts per `(signature, level)`, and ranks `SignatureGroup` items into an immutable `ScanReport`.

4. Output Formatting & Exit Gate (`formatter.py` & `cli.py`): Emits `render_json_report(report)` to stdout (`--format json`) or `build_rich_table(report)` via Rich Console (`--format table`), then exits with code 1 if `fail_above > 0` and `matched_events > fail_above` (otherwise 0).

state_and_storage: Stateless single-run CLI execution; no database, cache, or persistent mutable state.
In-memory immutable value objects (`LogEvent`, `SignatureGroup`, `ScanReport` in `src/logpulse/models.py`) and transient frequency dictionary (`buckets` in `src/logpulse/analyzer.py`).
execution_flow_map.error_and_concurrency_model: Single-threaded synchronous execution. Malformed JSONL lines are tolerated via `json.JSONDecodeError` / `isinstance(..., dict)` checks in `parser.py` and reported to `stderr`; missing input paths raise `typer.Exit(code=2)` and threshold breaches raise `typer.Exit(code=1)`, though `log_file.read_text()` lacks an explicit `OSError`/`UnicodeDecodeError` handler.

audit_dimensions.title: Evaluate Test Suite Completeness & Structure
audit_dimensions.summary: The pytest suite contains only 2 unit test functions across 2 files (`tests/test_parser.py`, `tests/test_analyzer.py`). While existing tests are deterministic, isolated, and assertion-backed, mirror test structure and boundary coverage are incomplete: `src/logpulse/cli.py` has zero `CliRunner` tests (leaving exit codes 0/1/2, `--fail-above`, and stderr warnings unverified) and `build_rich_table` in `src/logpulse/formatter.py` is untested.

audit_dimensions.title: Evaluate Repository Structure, Supply Chain & Dependencies
audit_dimensions.summary: logpulse adopts a modern PEP 621 pyproject.toml with uv_build, Python >=3.11, and separated dev dependency groups, with zero committed secrets. However, repository supply-chain governance is incomplete: SECURITY.md, Dependabot/Renovate automation, and CI workflows are absent, uv.lock is an unresolved stub lacking transitive package pins/hashes, and README.md omits installation, testing commands, and several CLI flags.

audit_dimensions.title: Evaluate Buildability, Offline Test Results, Measured Coverage & Startup Health
audit_dimensions.summary: Containerized runtime verification (`docker`, Python 3.12) passed clean image build (18.2s), hermetic `--network=none` pytest execution (2/2 passed in 2.61s), and CLI `--help` startup smoke check (1.33s). However, measured `pytest-cov` coverage is only 67.0% line (75/112 statements) and 33.3% branch, dragged down by 0.0% coverage in `src/logpulse/cli.py` (0/26 stmts) and 55.6% in `src/logpulse/formatter.py` (missing lines 43-50 in `build_rich_table`).

audit_dimensions.title: Evaluate CLI Ergonomics, Streams, Exit Codes & Automation UX
audit_dimensions.summary: logpulse implements strong clig.dev stream hygiene (`stdout` for Rich/JSON payloads vs `stderr` for diagnostics), CI-friendly `--format json`, `--no-color`, and `--fail-above` exit codes (0/1/2). However, `src/logpulse/cli.py` lacks `--version` and `-h` short help flags, defines a single `@app.command("scan")` without `@app.callback()` (which in Typer collapses the `scan` subcommand documented in README.md), lacks `stdin` (`-`) stream support, and dumps unhandled tracebacks on `OSError`/`UnicodeDecodeError`.

audit_dimensions.title: Evaluate Supply-Chain CVEs, Container Misconfigs, Secrets, Dangerous Sinks & API Boundaries
audit_dimensions.summary: Trivy container & filesystem security scanning (`trivy:0.69.3`) found 0 CRITICAL/HIGH application CVEs, 0 IaC misconfigurations, 0 leaked secrets, and 0 AST CWE sinks. Direct/transitive runtime libraries (`rich`, `typer`) have 0 CVEs; the 6 `python-pkg` CVEs (5 MEDIUM, 1 LOW) originate in the container image's bundled `pip@25.0.1` (fixed in `pip>=26.2.0`), while 398 OS-layer CVEs (9 CRITICAL, 91 HIGH) stem from the Debian 12.13 base image. Notably, `trivy_fs.json` confirmed that the stub `uv.lock` lists only `logpulse@0.2.1`, blinding static lockfile SCA unless full container resolution is run, and `SECURITY.md` + Dependabot remain absent.

audit_dimensions.title: Interpret Python AST Facts & Evaluate Quality/Typing/Imports/Security
audit_dimensions.summary: Python AST analysis confirms clean acyclic layering (0 circular dependencies across 6 modules / 207 LOC), 100% import hygiene, 100% function signature type coverage, and zero dangerous CWE code sinks or hardcoded secrets. Minor gaps exist in src/logpulse/formatter.py (two missing public docstrings reducing coverage to 88.9%, plus a dict[str, Any] return annotation), missing py.typed / static type-checker tooling, and boundary handling in src/logpulse/cli.py (eager read_text() memory load without OSError/UnicodeDecodeError exit-code-2 guard, and unvalidated min_level string input).

findings.evidence: uv.lock contains only [[package]] name = "logpulse" without resolved [[package]] entries or SHA-256 hashes for rich, typer, click, or pygments.
findings.description: Incomplete lockfile stub prevents deterministic, hash-verified dependency installation and weakens dependency vulnerability scanning.
findings.recommendation: Regenerate a complete deterministic lockfile using `uv lock` and enforce `uv sync --locked` in CI.

findings.evidence: tests/ contains only test_parser.py and test_analyzer.py (2 tests total); zero tests invoke typer.testing.CliRunner against logpulse.cli:app.
findings.description: Entire CLI entry point (`scan_cmd`), including missing-file exit code 2, `--fail-above` exit code 1, stderr malformed-line warnings, and `--format table|json` switching, has zero automated test coverage.
findings.recommendation: Add `tests/test_cli.py` using `typer.testing.CliRunner` and `tmp_path` fixtures to test exit codes 0, 1, and 2, stdout/stderr separation, `--format json`, and `--no-color`.

findings.evidence: app = typer.Typer(name="logpulse", ..., no_args_is_help=True) followed by a single @app.command("scan") without @app.callback(), --version, or context_settings={"help_option_names": ["-h", "--help"]}.
findings.description: Single `@app.command('scan')` without `@app.callback()` causes Typer to collapse `scan` into the root command (breaking `logpulse scan <file>` shown in README.md), and the CLI lacks `--version` and `-h` flags.
findings.recommendation: Add `@app.callback()` exposing `--version` (`importlib.metadata.version('logpulse')`) and configure `context_settings={'help_option_names': ['-h', '--help']}` on `typer.Typer` so both `logpulse --version` and `logpulse scan <file>` work as documented.

findings.evidence: lines = log_file.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines() loads entire file into RAM without try/except OSError or UnicodeDecodeError, and min_level: str (line 21) is not validated at the CLI boundary.
findings.description: scan_cmd reads entire log files eagerly into memory (risking OOM on large .jsonl files), fails to catch OSError/UnicodeDecodeError to emit documented exit code 2, and silently maps invalid --min-level values to INFO.
findings.recommendation: Stream `with log_file.open(encoding='utf-8', errors='replace') as fh:` directly into `parse_jsonl_lines(fh)` inside a `try/except OSError` block exiting with code 2, and constrain `--min-level` using an Enum/Literal choice.

findings.evidence: README.md (16 lines) documents --format and --no-color, omitting --min-level/-l, --fail-above, installation prerequisites, and `uv run pytest` development instructions.
findings.description: README.md omits Standard Readme installation/development sections and leaves `--min-level` and `--fail-above` CLI flags undocumented.
findings.recommendation: Expand README.md with Installation/Prerequisites, complete CLI flag table (`--min-level`, `--fail-above`, `--format`, `--no-color`), and Development/Testing commands.

findings.evidence: AstFacts.missing_docstrings: report_to_dict (line 13) and render_json_report (line 30) in src/logpulse/formatter.py.
findings.description: Two public serialization functions in `formatter.py` lack Google-style docstrings, lowering docstring coverage to 88.9%.
findings.recommendation: Add concise Google-style docstrings with Args and Returns sections to `report_to_dict` and `render_json_report`.

findings.evidence: def report_to_dict(report: ScanReport) -> dict[str, Any]: (also has_type_marker=false and no type checker in pyproject.toml).
findings.description: report_to_dict weakens return type safety with `dict[str, Any]`, the package omits PEP 561 `py.typed`, and `pyproject.toml` lacks a static type checker (`ty` or `pyright`) in dev dependencies.
findings.recommendation: Define `GroupDict` and `ScanReportDict` `TypedDict` classes for `report_to_dict`, add `src/logpulse/py.typed`, and add `ty` to `[dependency-groups].dev`.

action_plan.title: Regenerate Full Deterministic uv.lock with Transitive Hashes
action_plan.action: Run `uv lock` to populate full resolved versions and SHA-256 wheel/sdist hashes for rich, typer, and all transitive dependencies, then verify reproducibility with `uv sync --locked`.
action_plan.expected_impact: Guarantees reproducible builds and enables accurate CVE scanning across the full transitive dependency tree.

action_plan.title: Add Comprehensive CliRunner Integration Tests and Formatter Mirror Suite
action_plan.action: Create `tests/test_cli.py` using `typer.testing.CliRunner` to verify `logpulse scan` exit codes (`0`, `1`, `2`), `stdout` vs `stderr` separation, and `--format table|json`, plus `tests/test_formatter.py` for `build_rich_table` and edge-case tests in `test_parser.py`/`test_analyzer.py`.
action_plan.expected_impact: Raises measured package coverage from ~68% above 90% and prevents regressions in CLI subcommand routing and exit-code contracts.

action_plan.title: Add Typer @app.callback() with --version and -h Support to Preserve `scan` Subcommand
action_plan.action: Define `@app.callback()` with a `--version` / `-V` eager option and set `context_settings={'help_option_names': ['-h', '--help']}` on `app = typer.Typer(...)`, plus support `-` (`sys.stdin`) for piped JSONL streams.
action_plan.expected_impact: Aligns actual CLI invocation with `README.md` (`logpulse scan ...`), satisfies `clig.dev` `--version`/`-h` discoverability, and enables Unix stdin pipelines.

action_plan.title: Stream Log Files Safely and Enforce Strict CLI Boundary Validation
action_plan.action: Replace `log_file.read_text().splitlines()` with a streaming `log_file.open('r', encoding='utf-8')` context manager wrapped in `try/except (OSError, UnicodeDecodeError)` raising `typer.Exit(code=2)`, and type `--min-level` with a validated `Choice`/`Enum`.
action_plan.expected_impact: Eliminates unbounded memory allocation on large logs, guarantees exit code 2 on unreadable files, and rejects invalid severity flags early.

action_plan.title: Establish Supply-Chain Governance (SECURITY.md, Dependabot, Least-Privilege CI)
action_plan.action: Create SECURITY.md for vulnerability disclosure, add .github/dependabot.yml for automated weekly dependency PRs, and add a GitHub Actions workflow with `permissions: contents: read` and SHA-pinned actions.
action_plan.expected_impact: Aligns repository governance with OpenSSF Scorecard standards for token permissions, pinned CI dependencies, and automated vulnerability remediation.

action_plan.title: Close Measured Line (67.0% -> >90%) and Branch (33.3% -> >85%) Coverage Gaps
action_plan.action: Exercise missing statements in `src/logpulse/cli.py` (all 26 statements), `src/logpulse/formatter.py` (lines 43-50 `build_rich_table`), and `src/logpulse/parser.py` (lines 47, 54-55 blank and non-dict rows) via `pytest-cov`.
action_plan.expected_impact: Brings both line and branch coverage comfortably above the RV-03 80% / 70% healthy gate.

action_plan.title: Complete Standard Readme Sections and Full CLI Flag Reference
action_plan.action: Document prerequisites, installation (`uv sync`), development/testing commands (`uv run pytest`, `uv run ruff check`), and all `logpulse scan` flags (`--min-level`, `--fail-above`, `--format`, `--no-color`) in README.md, and expand LICENSE with full MIT text.
action_plan.expected_impact: Provides accurate onboarding, CI usage reference, and unambiguous license terms.

action_plan.title: Harden Container Packaging by Upgrading/Pruning `pip` and Refreshing Base OS Layers
action_plan.action: Ensure any CI/container build environment upgrades `pip>=26.2.0` (or omits `pip` from final `uv` venv images) and refreshes Debian security updates (`libgnutls30>=3.7.9-2+deb12u7`, `openssl>=3.0.20-1~deb12u2`).
action_plan.expected_impact: Eliminates all 6 `python-pkg` CVEs in `pip` and mitigates critical OS base-image vulnerabilities.

action_plan.title: Eliminate Any Return Type, Add Docstrings, and Configure Static Type Checking
action_plan.action: Replace `dict[str, Any]` in `report_to_dict` with `TypedDict` definitions, add Google-style docstrings to `report_to_dict` and `render_json_report`, add `py.typed`, and include `ty` in `[dependency-groups].dev`.
action_plan.expected_impact: Raises docstring coverage to 100%, removes all `Any` usages, and enforces static type verification in local and CI checks.

summary: logpulse (v0.2.1) achieves an overall PNI Software Health Score of 77/100 (Grade B). Its core architecture is clean, compact (207 LOC across 6 modules), strictly acyclic, and 100% type-annotated, passing containerized build, offline pytest, and CLI `--help` smoke verification with zero CRITICAL/HIGH Python dependency CVEs, zero secrets, and zero dangerous CWE code sinks. Primary remediation priorities are regenerating a complete hash-pinned `uv.lock` (P0), adding `CliRunner` and Rich formatter tests to lift measured coverage from 67.0% line / 33.3% branch above 85% (P0), preserving the `logpulse scan` subcommand and streaming file I/O safely in `cli.py` (P1), and establishing supply-chain governance (`SECURITY.md`, Dependabot, least-privilege CI) (P1).
